title: Leidos Partners With Rune on Military AI Logistics for Indo-Pacific | Rune Technologies News
summary: Leidos and Rune Technologies partnered to deploy AI systems that enable Indo-Pacific military commanders to anticipate logistics requirements before they impact operational effectiveness.
body_markdown:
The Defense Post covered Rune Technologies by Samantha Alexa in a piece titled “Leidos Partners With Rune on Military AI Logistics for Indo-Pacific.” Leidos and Rune Technologies partnered to deploy AI systems that enable Indo-Pacific military commanders to anticipate logistics requirements before they impact operational effectiveness.


Read the full article[here](https://thedefensepost.com/2026/07/15/leidos-rune-indo-pacific-ai/) .
